metadata.name: Pocasset V3 lidar-derived course features (16 Nov 2026)
metadata.note: Second locked file of features missing from the OpenStreetMap course source, traced from the locked lidar (the 15 Nov file is left unchanged). Merged at read time by tools/pcv3.py course_features(). All unverified until checked on the course.

properties.evidence: Owner (16 Nov 2026): on the back nine 'only hole 10 has water ... right in front of the tees'. 2021 USGS lidar: basin with a dead-flat floor at 5.7-5.8 m NAVD88 (hydro-flattened water surface), ~50 x 49 m, from ~16 m to ~65 m in front of the mapped Gold/Blue tee, 1.6 m below it, on the line of play.
properties.method: Cells of the locked 2 m course-area lidar grid connected to the flat surface and within 0.15 m of it (largest connected area only; a 38-cell flat patch beside the tee left out); outline smoothed (0.75 cell Gaussian at 8x) and simplified to 0.4 m; area ~1,490 m2.
properties.approved: Owner report, 16 Nov 2026 (traced as for the Hole 8 pond)
